_comment: Item 2hc (v1.3.0/W2): the pin for the one native file Agent_b ships that it did not build.
The WebView2 runtime does NOT provide this loader (measured in v1.3.0/W1: the runtime ships
EmbeddedBrowserWebView.dll only), so every WebView2 application carries its own copy - Office,
OneDrive and Citrix each have one on this machine. Ours comes from Microsoft's own SDK package
and is verified by BOTH hash and Authenticode signature before the installer copies it.
Rejected alternative: github.com/jchv/go-webview2, which embeds three copies of this DLL and
maps one into executable memory with VirtualAlloc/VirtualProtect. See NOTES.md, 2026-09-22.
